quote: the Company entered into a Transaction Agreement with Amazon.com, Inc. ("Amazon", including its affiliates) and related Warrant, under which the Company issued to Amazon a warrant (the "Warrant") to acquire up to 1,045,171 shares (the "Warrant Shares") of Company common stock (the "Common Stock").
trigger_description: The Warrant Shares vest based on Amazon's purchases of photonic fabric products, indirectly or directly, through December 31, 2030.
